source_text: Issue #3, set in Kenya, specifically challenges mass circumcision campaigns promoted for HIV reduction (citing trials showing around 60% efficacy), portraying them as coercive and ineffective against broader transmission dynamics, prioritizing the infant's right to an unaltered body over probabilistic health gains.
